other_conditions: Beneficiaries must belong to the small and marginal economic category.
Preference is given to women self‑help groups and unemployed youths.
Beneficiaries must own land at their premises or have long‑term lease of rented land.
Each beneficiary can receive only one unit of up to 200 sqm.
Selection is done by the District Level Beneficiaries Selection Committee through mass‑media publicity.
The committee monitors the program and reports progress fortnightly.
benefits_summary: Government provides planting material, shade net, and a garden tool kit, while beneficiaries construct the structure and cover preparation costs, with technical support from officials.
